item.title: Turnitin Warns Customers of Unauthorized Access to its Systems - An Adaptive Security Solution Could Help Identify Risks
item.description:
Turnitin Warns Customers of Unauthorized Access to its Systems - An Adaptive Security Solution Could Help Identify Risks

🔍 Overview

Turnitin, an educational technology company, reports unauthorized access to their customer-facing systems. The investigation continues, and law enforcement and cyber regulators have been notified. The affected systems do not collect government IDs or financial information, but it’s unclear if sensitive user data has been accessed. Adaptive Security’s AI-based solution could help identify related risks. No disruptions are visible on the platform’s status page. However, it’s essential to reassess Turnitin’s email security features in the face of potential threats.

🧩 How it works

Adaptive Security’s AI agents analyze email intent to uncover phishing, business email compromise, and invoice fraud. They utilize machine learning models trained on real-world threat data, providing a clear picture of potential risks. By analyzing email context and behavior in real-time, the system can detect threats that might bypass traditional filters. The solution starts with a 14-day free email security scan, compatible with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.

⚙️ Key details

  • Turnitin: Educational technology company with global presence, known for AI writing detection, digital grading, academic research integrity checks, and examination proctoring. Serves 71 million students across 16,0000+ institutions in 185 countries.
  • Adaptive Security: AI-based solution that could potentially help identify risks related to Turnitin’s unauthorized access incident.

🚀 Availability

Adaptive Security’s email security solution is available for a free 14-day scan of Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace with no MX changes. Start your free scan here: Deploy Email Security Agent

💡 Why it matters

Assessing Turnitin’s email security features becomes crucial in the wake of this incident. Users should remain cautious about sharing sensitive data on the platform, and IT admins should consider implementing additional measures to protect against similar attacks. AI-based solutions, such as Adaptive Security, can aid in detecting risks missed by traditional filters. Follow BleepingComputer for updates on this incident and the latest cybersecurity news. With the recent unauthorized access, it’s important to keep informed and stay protected.

item.title: N-able cyberattack disrupts Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services
item.description:
N-able cyberattack disrupts Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services

N-able reported a cyberattack that breached a server in its Hosted Cloud environment, leading to a worldwide outage of the Mail Assume and SpamExperts services.

🔍 Overview

  • Attackers breached one of N-able’s servers, causing a major outage of Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services worldwide.
  • The outage initially was attributed to a “combination of platform configuration and service dependencies.”
  • N-able later confirmed unauthorized access to a server in the Hosted Cloud environment.

📅 Timeline

  • On Tuesday, N-able described the disruption as a configuration and dependency issue affecting the Americas, Asia‑Pacific, and Europe.
  • The following day, UI and API access were disabled and unauthorized server access was confirmed.
  • An email alert was sent to customers after the attack was detected.

⚙️ Impact

  • Email flow and spam filtering continued to operate; N-able said there is no evidence that attackers accessed customer data or mailboxes.
  • Customers could not sign in to the control panel, view or release quarantined messages, review logs, or modify domain configurations until services are restored.
  • The management portal (dashboard) and supporting services for quarantine, logging, and mailbox synchronization were taken down.

🛡️ Response

  • N-able disabled UI and API access, took down the management portal, and began mitigation steps.
  • The company is hardening services to reduce the risk of recurrence.
  • Investigation is ongoing, with no current evidence of compromised customer data.
  • N-able clarified that the incident is unrelated to a separate N‑central outage caused by more than 30 zero‑day flaws.

💡 Why it matters

  • Highlights the risk of unauthorized server access even when core email delivery remains functional.
  • Demonstrates the importance of rapid customer communication and service isolation during a security incident.
  • Shows that a single breached server can impact globally distributed cloud email security services.

#N-able #Cyberattack #EmailSecurity #CloudOutage

Source: N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage
